description: This file defines a utility function 'aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost' that aggregates agent costs and usage data from MongoDB collections 'session_tracking' and 'llm-costs'. It processes and merges data from different structures, normalizes currency strings, and supports filtering options. The main purpose is to provide a summarized view of agent usage and costs across sessions.

methods.name: toNumberSafe
methods.description: A helper function that safely converts currency-like strings (e.g., '$0.108255') or other inputs into numeric values, returning 0 for invalid or non-numeric inputs.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that queries MongoDB collections, processes and merges agent cost and usage data, applies filters, and returns a summarized list of agents with total costs, usage, and session counts.
